Replace the turn count only cursor with versioned durable source progress sufficient to export a still open turn and late tool results on both harnesses. Use deterministic observation identities, per accepted batch acknowledgement and atomic progress; Stop and active flush share the same protocol and concurrent exports serialize. Persist only masked IO if durable buffering is needed; bound pending bytes and report overflow. Failed or uncertain acknowledgements remain retryable with the same identifiers, never counted accepted or silently dropped. Preserve existing trace hierarchy, fields and all supported IO; report unsupported IO and exact masked field truncation. Done when merged and partial failure, lost acknowledgement, duplicate Stop, compaction, handoff and late result controls produce one logical downstream observation each.
